Rina: pasted a compact mock for the min/max + top-up row — https://figma.link/compact-topup — main asks: microcopy alternatives for 'burst', keyboard shortcuts, and bulk edit behavior when multiple pools selected. Devon: quick thought: 'burst' -> 'Spike capacity' or 'Peak top-up'. 'Spike' feels more customer-friendly than 'burst'. Kai: accessibility: keyboard shortcut proposal: Alt+K to focus the min stepper, Alt+L for max. need to ensure we don't conflict with browser / OS. also the stepper should announce the delta, e.g., 'Max increased to 6 GPUs (+1)'. Helena: bulk edit edge-case: if user selects two pools with different max limits we show mixed state. propose showing "Multiple values" and allow 'Apply to all' with a confirmation toast that lists affected pools. Rina: copy variants: A) 'Top up for spikes' B) 'Temporary peak' C) 'Spike capacity'. prefer A for tone. Devon: keyboard visibility: when using keyboard to adjust a value, show inline tooltip with the numeric preview and estimated cost; tooltip should persist while focused. Kai: ARIA: use aria-live="assertive" when the change is an error (e.g., min > max) and polite for cost changes. example: role="alert" for validation, role="status" for cost. Helena: validation copy: avoid negative language. instead of 'Invalid: min > max' use 'Guaranteed must be <= Max capacity' and show action button 'Set Max to Guaranteed' (focusable). Rina: UX flow for mixed bulk edits: disabled fields should have tooltip: 'This pool enforces a max of 4 GPUs'. CTA 'Apply override' should open a confirmation sheet. OpsBot: deployment note: top-up availability depends on pool tags (preemptible vs dedicated). We should surface a small badge: 'Top-ups: limited' with tooltip. QA: test plan asks: keyboard-only path, screen reader announce on value change, bulk-apply confirmation, and contrast on top-up CTA. I'll draft cases. Devon: contrast note: try swapping CTA to dark navy on white rather than teal to improve AA compliance. Kai: small aria example:
Estimate: $0.84/hr
. Debounce cost updates by 300ms per earlier perf notes. Rina: decisions: use 'Top up for spikes' copy, implement 'Apply to all' for bulk edits, surface pool-level top-up availability, and add keyboard shortcuts (docs will list if conflicts arise). I'll update Figma and open a PR with the a11y changes. any objections? Helena: no objections. I'll prototype the bulk confirmation sheet. Devon: +1 on copy. QA: i'll start writing tests and tag the PR. Rina: thanks — will post updated link when ready. :heavy_check_mark:
